+## #2868 - Indexed and tilted pocket example
+
+**What was decided:** Add an original 30 × 30 × 35 mm block with three 8 × 8 × 2 mm pockets.
+Use whole-model 2D Pocket operations at A90 B0, A−90 B0, and A30 B30.
+Use the built-in `Tilt-head 5-axis` machine and the 6 mm `EM-0600-4FL` cutter with 15 mm flutes.
+Fit box stock to the model with zero margin and embed the model in the project.
+Require verification before the script saves the project or posts the NC program.
+
+**Why:** The two opposite faces show single-axis indexing, and the sloped face shows two-axis indexing.
+The compact stock keeps the full projected stock envelope above the tilted floor within the cutter's flute length.
+The maximum distance is approximately 14.122 mm.
+The built-in machine and embedded mesh make the case portable.
+The example uses existing commands and keeps all verification checks enabled.
+
+**Considered and dropped:** A 60 × 60 × 70 mm design encountered a false collision refusal caused by mixed coordinate frames.
+Issue #3004 records that verifier defect separately.
+This example does not change the verifier.
+Picked tilted source faces are not supported, so the operations use the whole model.
+Production algorithm changes are outside this example task.
+
+**Verification scope:** The column stock simulation cannot judge posed operations.
+The geometric gouge and collision checks still run.
+The example has no holder or fixture model, and no physical CNC machine was run.
+Verification does not prove complete stock removal.
+The cutter leaves material in the sharp inside corners of the square pockets.
+
+**Cost to change later:** Regenerate the mesh, project, and NC program after a geometry or tool change.
+Update the pinning tests and the case README to match.

+# Indexed and tilted pockets
+
+This original example shows 3+1 indexed work on two opposite faces and 3+2 work on a sloped face.
+Each operation uses a fixed tool axis during the cut.
+The rotary axes move between operations.
+
+The starting stock is a 30 × 30 × 35 mm box, centered at the origin.
+Its bounds are X−15 to X15, Y−15 to Y15, and Z−17.5 to Z17.5.
+The script fits this box to the model with zero margin.
+The finished model removes one corner above the plane `n · p = 15`, where `n = (√3/4, −0.5, 0.75)`.
+The model also has three square pockets, each 8 × 8 mm and 2 mm deep along its face normal.
+
+| Order | Operation | Pocket center (mm) | Index | Floor distance along tool axis (mm) |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Front pocket | (−5, −15, −5) | A90 B0 | 13 |
+| 2 | Back pocket | (−5, 15, −5) | A−90 B0 | 13 |
+| 3 | Tilted pocket | (6.495191, −7.5, 11.25) | A30 B30 | 13 |
+
+The first two operations index only A.
+The third operation indexes both A and B.
+The built-in `Tilt-head 5-axis` machine supplies the rotary axes.
+All three operations use the 6 mm flat end mill `EM-0600-4FL`, without a holder.
+They use 2 mm stepdowns, 2 mm stepovers, and zero wall allowance.
+The compact stock keeps the largest projected stock height above the floor within the tool's 15 mm flute length.
+That distance is approximately 14.122 mm for the tilted operation.
+No verification check is disabled.
+
+Each operation uses the whole model as its source.
+CamCraft currently refuses tilted operations that use picked source faces.
+The whole-model path preserves the material sections around each pocket.
+The box stock includes material above the sloped face, so the third operation also removes this corner stock.
+Its starting height comes from the stock bounds along the tilted tool axis.
+
+Inspect the three pocket orientations in the project.
+Inspect the A and B index words before each operation's cutting moves in `indexed.nc`.
+The model mesh is embedded in `indexed.camproj`; the project has no external model link.
+The generator checks that the mesh is closed and consistently oriented.
+
+The script requires a clean verification result before it saves the project or posts the program.
+Stock simulation cannot judge posed operations; the geometric gouge and collision checks still run.
+Verification does not prove complete stock removal.
+The 6 mm cutter leaves material in the sharp inside corners of each square pocket.
+Its radius is 3 mm.
+No physical CNC machine was run.
+The example has no fixture or holder model.
+
+From the repository root, regenerate the model and rebuild the case:
+
+```sh
+python3 examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/model/gen_indexed_obj.py
+cargo xtask catalog --case multiaxis/indexed
+```
+
+Check the catalog and its project tests:
+
+```sh
+cargo xtask catalog --check
+cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog
+```

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Provenance: original planar block and pocket construction using elementary plane intersections.
+"""Generate a closed block with two indexed pockets and one sloped-face pocket."""
+import itertools
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def dot(a, b):
+    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
+
+
+def add(a, b, scale=1.0):
+    return tuple(x + scale * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
+
+
+def cross(a, b):
+    return (a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1], a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2], a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0])
+
+
+def basis(n):
+    seed = min(range(3), key=lambda i: abs(n[i]))
+    u = add(tuple(float(i == seed) for i in range(3)), n, -n[seed])
+    length = math.sqrt(dot(u, u))
+    u = tuple(x / length for x in u)
+    return u, cross(n, u)
+
+
+N = (math.sqrt(3) / 4, -0.5, 0.75)  # Ry(30) Rx(30) Z.
+PLANES = [((1., 0., 0.), 15.), ((-1., 0., 0.), 15.),
+          ((0., 1., 0.), 15.), ((0., -1., 0.), 15.),
+          ((0., 0., 1.), 17.5), ((0., 0., -1.), 17.5), (N, 15.)]
+POCKETS = {2: (-5., 15., -5.), 3: (-5., -15., -5.),
+           6: tuple(15*x for x in N)}
+HALF = 4.0
+DEPTH = 2.0
+
+
+def vertices():
+    """Intersect each three supporting planes of this convex blank."""
+    points = set()
+    for (a, ha), (b, hb), (c, hc) in itertools.combinations(PLANES, 3):
+        det = dot(a, cross(b, c))
+        if abs(det) < 1e-10:
+            continue
+        p = tuple((ha*x + hb*y + hc*z) / det
+                  for x, y, z in zip(cross(b, c), cross(c, a), cross(a, b)))
+        if all(dot(n, p) <= h + 1e-8 for n, h in PLANES):
+            points.add(tuple(round(x, 9) for x in p))
+    return sorted(points)
+
+
+def panels():
+    points = vertices()
+    faces = []
+    for index, (n, height) in enumerate(PLANES):
+        outer = [p for p in points if abs(dot(n, p) - height) < 1e-7]
+        u, v = basis(n)
+        center = POCKETS.get(index, tuple(sum(p[i] for p in outer)/len(outer) for i in range(3)))
+
+        def angle(p):
+            delta = add(p, center, -1)
+            return math.atan2(dot(delta, v), dot(delta, u))
+
+        outer.sort(key=angle)
+        if index not in POCKETS:
+            faces.append(outer)
+            continue
+        # Rays through every outer vertex and pocket corner partition the annulus.
+        corners = [add(add(center, u, x), v, y)
+                   for x, y in [(-HALF, -HALF), (HALF, -HALF),
+                                (HALF, HALF), (-HALF, HALF)]]
+        angles = sorted(set(round(angle(p), 12) for p in outer + corners))
+        rim, hole = [], []
+        for theta in angles:
+            x, y = math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)
+            direction = add(tuple(x*t for t in u), v, y)
+            distance = min((h-dot(m, center))/dot(m, direction)
+                           for m, h in PLANES if dot(m, direction) > 1e-8)
+            inner = HALF / max(abs(x), abs(y))
+            if distance <= inner + 0.1:
+                raise ValueError("pocket crosses an outer edge")
+            rim.append(add(center, direction, distance))
+            hole.append(add(center, direction, inner))
+        floor = [add(p, n, -DEPTH) for p in hole]
+        for i in range(len(angles)):
+            j = (i + 1) % len(angles)
+            faces.append([rim[i], rim[j], hole[j], hole[i]])
+            faces.append([hole[i], hole[j], floor[j], floor[i]])
+        faces.append(floor)
+    return faces
+
+
+def mesh():
+    faces = [[tuple(round(x, 8) for x in p) for p in f] for f in panels()]
+    points = sorted(set(p for f in faces for p in f))
+    triangles = []
+    # Match subdivisions across adjacent panels before triangulation.
+    for face in faces:
+        border = []
+        for p, q in zip(face, face[1:] + face[:1]):
+            edge = add(q, p, -1)
+            length2 = dot(edge, edge)
+            on_edge = []
+            for r in points:
+                delta = add(r, p, -1)
+                t = dot(delta, edge) / length2
+                residual = add(delta, edge, -t)
+                if -1e-9 <= t < 1-1e-9 and dot(residual, residual) < 1e-14:
+                    on_edge.append((t, r))
+            border.extend(r for _, r in sorted(on_edge))
+        center = tuple(round(sum(p[i] for p in border)/len(border), 8) for i in range(3))
+        for p, q in zip(border, border[1:] + border[:1]):
+            triangles.append((center, p, q))
+    # Every directed edge must occur once and have one reverse edge.
+    edges = set()
+    for tri in triangles:
+        area = cross(add(tri[1], tri[0], -1), add(tri[2], tri[0], -1))
+        if dot(area, area) < 1e-14:
+            raise ValueError("degenerate triangle")
+        for edge in zip(tri, tri[1:] + tri[:1]):
+            if edge in edges:
+                raise ValueError("repeated directed edge")
+            edges.add(edge)
+    if any((q, p) not in edges for p, q in edges):
+        raise ValueError("mesh has an open edge")
+    return triangles
+
+
+def main():
+    triangles = mesh()
+    points = sorted(set(p for tri in triangles for p in tri))
+    ids = {p: i+1 for i, p in enumerate(points)}
+    lines = ["# Original indexed block: 30 x 30 x 35 mm; three 8 x 8 x 2 mm pockets."]
+    lines += ["v %.8f %.8f %.8f" % p for p in points]
+    lines += ["f " + " ".join(str(ids[p]) for p in tri) for tri in triangles]
+    out = Path(__file__).with_name("indexed.obj")
+    out.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+    print(f"{out.name}: {len(points)} vertices, {len(triangles)} triangles; closed oriented mesh")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
